description: Juniper SRX firewall structured syslog RT_FLOW messages

session_create.template: <14>1 {{ts}} {{hostname}} RT_FLOW - RT_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE [junos@2636.1.1.1.2.129 source-address="{{src_addr}}" source-port="{{src_port}}" destination-address="{{dst_addr}}" destination-port="{{dst_port}}" service-name="{{service}}" nat-source-address="{{nat_src_addr}}" nat-source-port="{{nat_src_port}}" protocol-id="{{proto_id}}" policy-name="{{policy}}" source-zone-name="{{src_zone}}" destination-zone-name="{{dst_zone}}" session-id-32="{{session_id}}"]

session_close.template: <14>1 {{ts}} {{hostname}} RT_FLOW - RT_FLOW_SESSION_CLOSE [junos@2636.1.1.1.2.129 reason="{{reason}}" source-address="{{src_addr}}" source-port="{{src_port}}" destination-address="{{dst_addr}}" destination-port="{{dst_port}}" service-name="{{service}}" protocol-id="{{proto_id}}" policy-name="{{policy}}" source-zone-name="{{src_zone}}" destination-zone-name="{{dst_zone}}" session-id-32="{{session_id}}" packets-from-client="{{pkts_client}}" bytes-from-client="{{bytes_client}}" packets-from-server="{{pkts_server}}" bytes-from-server="{{bytes_server}}" elapsed-time="{{elapsed}}"]

session_deny.template: <12>1 {{ts}} {{hostname}} RT_FLOW - RT_FLOW_SESSION_DENY [junos@2636.1.1.1.2.129 source-address="{{src_addr}}" source-port="{{src_port}}" destination-address="{{dst_addr}}" destination-port="{{dst_port}}" service-name="{{service}}" protocol-id="{{proto_id}}" icmp-type="0" policy-name="{{policy}}" source-zone-name="{{src_zone}}" destination-zone-name="{{dst_zone}}" session-id-32="{{session_id}}"]
